un_source.title: UN DESA World Urbanization Prospects 2025, File 21
un_source.definition: Degree of Urbanization city (contiguous built-up area), not a legal municipality

methodology.coverage_claim: anchor municipality only; never full UN built-up-area coverage
methodology.note: A city is covered only when the named legal fiscal entity has a served PSD artifact with native line items. Country headline totals and warehouse-only rows do not count.

city_blockers.6030: Tokyo's UN built-up area has no single municipality. The current Japan layer covers municipalities and Tokyo's special wards, not a consolidated Tokyo built-up-area government.
city_blockers.332: The current KOR layer contains only four headline classifications. Seoul has a separate official project-level budget/expenditure API and needs a dedicated adapter.
city_blockers.2033: Nairobi City County is the legal-government anchor, not the full UN built-up area. Official Bajeti Yetu county-id-47 implementation records are document previews; CSV/XLS grid export covers document metadata, while Controller of Budget implementation reports are PDFs. No official machine-readable coded Nairobi County line endpoint was verified in Cloud Builds 2c511353-18ce-4f9d-bfd6-e2c02079ddc6 and 3743cdf4-917e-46ba-bae3-6e362ce123ee.

priority_official_sources.boundary: Seoul Metropolitan Government; autonomous districts and affiliated bodies excluded
priority_official_sources.source_note: Official dataset exposes project, account, department, budget, expenditure and remaining balance. The cloud-ready adapter is not loaded because the required API key and reviewed case-sensitive service identifier are absent from Secret Manager.

priority_official_sources.boundary: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
priority_official_sources.source_note: Official expenditure-by-subhead CSV loaded to the production municipal warehouse as 1,148 stage-specific facts from 331 source rows. This is territory-government anchor coverage, not a municipality or full built-up-area consolidation.
Official machine-readable sector series is verified, but its 25 rows may not satisfy PSD's native line-item threshold; detailed MOF estimates should be preferred.

priority_official_sources.boundary: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, not the full UN built-up area
priority_official_sources.format: official budget tables; dedicated review required
priority_official_sources.source_note: Do not substitute a special ward or claim full agglomeration coverage.

priority_official_sources.boundary: City of Cape Town metropolitan municipality
priority_official_sources.format: official budget documents / data portal review
priority_official_sources.source_note: Strong fiscal-boundary match; only load after locating and hashing the official detailed machine-readable schedule.
